permittedTransformations.rule: Quote style, trailing commas, and insignificant whitespace may differ after TypeScript printer normalization.
Adapted suites import Octane sources and @octanejs/testing-library; pristine suites import relative React upstream modules and @testing-library/react.
Component test files may use .tsrx instead of .tsx; a few utilities move under components/{group,panel}/.
expect(node).toHaveAttribute(name, value) maps to expect(node.getAttribute(name)).toBe(value); bare toHaveAttribute(name) maps to hasAttribute(name)).toBe(true).
Layout-effect invariant failures observed via React RTL toThrow map to captureLayoutEffectError(...).toBe(true) because Octane reports those exceptions through console.error.
React Profiler render-count expects and surrounding Profiler wrappers collapse to the Panel-children re-render invariant Octane can observe without Profiler.
cases: Panel memoization Panels contents should not re-render on Group layout change

permittedTransformations.rule: Numeric style zero may serialize as '0' (React/jsdom) or '0px' (Octane CSSOM normalization) for minHeight/minWidth.
createRef<T>() may be written as an explicit { current: null } ref object literal under Octane typings.
Adapted support fixtures may remap relative type imports to Octane package sources under src/.

global/test/moveSeparator.ts substitutes @testing-library/user-event and node:assert with tests/upstream/test/userEvent.ts plus the package assert helper; the authored adapter must keep pointer/type exports and the PointerEvent/KeyboardEvent dispatch behavioral contract (not only a refreshable structural hash).

divergences.rule: Upstream mocks React.useId to return ':r123:'; Octane's useId fallback is framework-owned and cannot reproduce that mock, so the adapted case asserts a non-empty string instead.
